title: Set up criterion benchmark harness in workspace
description:
Add a benches/ directory to usenet-ipfs-core (and later transit/reader). Configure criterion in Cargo.toml. Add a placeholder benchmark (canonicalize 1000 articles) as the first entry. Artifact: crates/core/benches/canonical.rs, criterion config in Cargo.toml.

Acceptance: `cargo bench -p usenet-ipfs-core` runs without error; benchmark output includes mean/std
